description: PDF/EPUB Reader Refactor - Fix blur/rotation issues, implement continuous scroll with mouse wheel navigation

userStories.title: Install react-reader dependency for EPUB
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to install react-reader so we can use it for EPUB continuous scroll support.
acceptanceCriteria: Install react-reader npm package
Install @types/epubjs if needed for TypeScript
Verify package.json includes react-reader dependency
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Installed react-reader@^2.0.15. Package includes built-in TypeScript types, no @types/epubjs needed.

userStories.title: Migrate EPUB reader to react-reader with continuous scroll
userStories.description: As a user, I want to read EPUBs with smooth scrolling and complete chapter content.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace custom epubjs with ReactReader component
Configure flow: 'scrolled', manager: 'continuous', spread: 'none'
Display current chapter name in header
Remove previous/next navigation buttons
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: EPUB content displays fully and scrolls smoothly
userStories.notes: ReactReader configured with continuous scroll, chapter display in header, navigation buttons hidden via readerStyles

userStories.title: EPUB support chapter/CFI navigation from graph
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a concept in the graph and jump to the corresponding chapter.
acceptanceCriteria: ReactReader accepts highlightAnchor (CFI) prop for navigation
ReactReader accepts chapterHref prop for chapter navigation
Smooth scroll to target position when navigating
Update current chapter display in header
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: click concept node jumps to correct chapter
userStories.notes: EPUBReader already supports highlightAnchor (CFI) and chapterHref navigation props. Navigation triggers smooth scroll via setLocation.

userStories.title: Fix PDF high-DPI blur with devicePixelRatio
userStories.description: As a user on Retina/4K displays, I want PDF text to be crisp and clear.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect window.devicePixelRatio in PDFReader
Set canvas.width = CSS width * devicePixelRatio
Set canvas.height = CSS height * devicePixelRatio
Call context.scale(dpr, dpr) before render
Text renders sharply on high-DPI screens
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser on Retina display: text is sharp
userStories.notes: Canvas dimensions now multiplied by window.devicePixelRatio. Context scaled by DPR before render.

userStories.title: Fix PDF content rotation issue
userStories.description: As a user, I want PDFs with rotated pages to display correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Get viewport.rotation from page.getViewport({scale: 1})
Pass rotation to getViewport({ scale, rotation }) when rendering
Pages with rotation metadata display correctly oriented
Typecheck passes
Verify with rotated PDF: content displays correctly
userStories.notes: Rotation from baseViewport passed to scaled viewport. Handles rotated PDF pages correctly.

userStories.title: Implement PDF virtual scrolling base
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the foundation for PDF continuous scroll with Intersection Observer.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scroll container with overflow-y: scroll
Use IntersectionObserver to track visible pages
Maintain pool of 3-5 canvas elements for visible pages
Calculate page positions and total scroll height
Render pages only when they enter viewport
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: scroll through PDF, pages load on demand
userStories.notes: Virtual scrolling implemented with scroll container, page position calculation, and on-demand rendering.

userStories.title: Complete PDF virtual scrolling with page tracking
userStories.description: As a user, I want to scroll through PDF smoothly and see current page in header.
acceptanceCriteria: Track current visible page during scroll
Update page number display in header in real-time
Support scroll-to-page via pageNumber prop
Support mouse wheel, touchpad, scrollbar navigation
Add smooth scroll animation for programmatic navigation
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: scroll smoothly, header shows correct page
userStories.notes: Virtual scrolling includes real-time page tracking, smooth navigation, and scroll-to-page support.

userStories.title: Unify reader interface and remove navigation buttons
userStories.description: As a user, I want a consistent reading interface for both PDF and EPUB.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove previous/next page buttons from PDF reader
Unify header styling between PDF and EPUB readers
Both show current position (page number or chapter name)
Consistent loading states
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: UI is clean and consistent for both formats
userStories.notes: Both readers have consistent header styling (border-b bg-muted/50). Navigation buttons removed from both.
